concept: Seeing how a change in one part of a system affects other parts, sometimes unexpectedly
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student changes one variable in a realistic system (a schedule, a team structure, a budget) and traces the ripple effects on other parts
exercise.branching_choice: Student predicts consequences before seeing them play out
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on which ripple effects were expected and which were surprising

assessment.success_marker: student identifies at least one unexpected ripple effect, not just the obvious direct outcome
